text.p: Summaries of European Cup rugby union matches on Saturday:
Pontypridd - Try: Martyn Willims; Conversion: Neil Jenkins. Penalties: Jenkins (7).
Treviso - Try: Francesco Mazzariol. Con: Mazzariol. Pens: Mazzariol (5).
Bath - Tries: Jeremy Guscott (2), Adedayo Adebayo, Jon Callard, Jason Robinson, Steve Ojomoh, Victor Ubogu; Cons: Callard (7), Pens: Callard (2).
Edinburgh - Tries: Duncan Hodge, Derek Lee. Cons: Hodge (2); Pens: Hodge (4).
Llanelli - Tries: Chris Wyatt, Rupert Moon, Neil Boobyer; Cons: Frano Botica (2); Pens: Botica (5)
Leinster - Tries: Gavin, McKenna, O'Mahony. Con: Governy
Munster: Try: Brian Begley; Pens: Begley (5), Killian Keane. Milan: Try: Frederico Williams.
Pau - Tries: Benjamin Lhande (4), Scott Keith (2), David Aucagne (2), Nicolas Brusc, Thierry Cleda, Christophe Paillet, Alain Lagouarde, penalty try. Cons: Aucagne (8), Thierry Duces (2).
Borders - Tries: Hogg, Nichol, Turnbull, Moncrieff. Cons: Parker (4).
Brive - Tries: Sebastien Carrat (4), Sebastien Viars; Pens: Viars (3).
Neath - Tries: Chris Higgs, penalty try, Patrick Horgan; Cons: Darren Morris (2).
